name: TutorTrack — Tutoring & Lessons Manager
description: A lessons manager for tutoring studios and music teachers: keep student and tutor profiles, schedule lessons, record progress notes, and raise invoices. Includes 5 forms and 1 app.

packMeta.name: TutorTrack — Tutoring & Lessons Manager
packMeta.description: A tutoring and lessons manager for studios, music teachers, language teachers and coaching centres: keep a student roster and tutor bench, book and track lessons, record progress notes, and bill with invoices — all linked together.
packMeta.author: FormLogic

forms.title: Student
forms.description: Enrol a student with guardian contacts, their subject or instrument, level and learning goals.

fields.label: New Student
fields.description: Capture the student and guardian details so lessons, progress and billing stay in one place.

properties.placeholder: What the student wants to achieve, exam dates, repertoire, focus areas…

forms.title: Tutor
forms.description: Add a tutor to the bench with their subjects, weekly availability and hourly rate.

fields.label: New Tutor
fields.description: Add a tutor with the subjects they teach and the days they can take lessons.

forms.title: Lesson
forms.description: Book a lesson linking a student and tutor, with date, time, duration, status and fee.

fields.label: Book a Lesson
fields.description: Schedule a lesson and keep its outcome and fee on record.

properties.placeholder: What was covered, wins, things to revisit next time…

forms.title: Progress Note
forms.description: Record how a lesson went: the progress area, a score, notes and any homework assigned.

fields.label: New Progress Note
fields.description: A quick note after a lesson keeps every student’s progress visible term after term.

properties.placeholder: What improved, what needs work, how the student felt…
Exercises, pages, pieces or practice minutes for next time…

forms.title: Invoice
forms.description: Raise an invoice for a student covering a billing period, with amount, status and due date.

fields.label: New Invoice
fields.description: Bill a student for a period of lessons and track it through to paid.

apps.name: TutorTrack
apps.description: A tutoring studio hub: manage the student roster and tutor bench, book and track lessons, log progress notes, and stay on top of billing from one dashboard.

roles.name: Studio Owner
roles.description: Full access to every TutorTrack form.

roles.name: Studio Coordinator
roles.description: Front-desk staff who enrol students, book lessons and manage billing.

roles.name: Tutor
roles.description: Tutors who see their students and lessons, update outcomes and log progress notes.

reports.name: Total lessons
reports.description: Count of every lesson booked across the studio.

reports.name: Lessons by status
reports.description: Count of lessons broken down by their current status.

reports.name: Lesson revenue
reports.description: Total fees summed across all lessons.

reports.name: Lessons by tutor
reports.description: Lesson counts grouped by the linked tutor.

reports.name: Invoices by status
reports.description: Count of invoices broken down by billing status.

reports.name: Tutoring studio overview
reports.description: High-level summary of lesson activity, tutor workload and billing.

blocks.title: Tutoring studio overview
blocks.body: This report summarises lesson activity, tutor workload and billing across the studio. Use it to monitor how many lessons are being taught, which tutors carry the load, how revenue is tracking, and where invoices sit in the billing cycle.

blocks.caption: Every lesson booked across the studio.
